what_it_is: The order a new member goes through: Register, Pre-Course Quiz, Onboarding (software setup, training videos, answer key), Standard Building Hands-on Training in Ginger, Rules & Guidelines, specialized trainings (Landcover, Transportation, Roof), then live projects and earnings in the Wallet.
how_to: Register an account
Finish the Pre-Course Quiz
Complete every Onboarding step on the Dashboard
Get the Ginger ID and password from Account Info
Pass the Standard Building Hands-on Training in Ginger
Finish Rules & Guidelines under Projects
Take the required specialized trainings
Register for live projects and start earning
conditions: Each stage unlocks the next one. Projects and Wallet stay locked until Standard Building is passed.

what_it_is: The Create an Account form. Members sign up with their details or with Google. After signing up, the site shows the new Username and Password to copy and save.
how_to: Open the Sign up page
Fill in First Name, Last Name, Email Address, Phone Number, Password, Confirm Password, Facebook Profile Link and Referrer
Agree to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy, or click Continue with Google
Copy and save the Username and Password shown on the Registration Successful screen
Click Proceed to Pre-course
conditions: When registration is closed, the page shows 'Registration is Closed' and only existing accounts can log in.

what_it_is: The Sign In page, using Email Address and Password or Continue with Google.
how_to: Go to the Sign In page
Enter Email Address and Password, or click Continue with Google
Click Sign In
conditions: Accounts created with Google may be asked to complete their profile (name, Facebook link, phone, referrer, password) before continuing.

what_it_is: A short quiz with videos and info slides about the Ginger labeling tools and the 3D guidelines. Finishing it creates the member's software accounts ('Creating Your Account').
how_to: Watch each video and read each slide
Answer each question, then click Next
Finish every page; the system then sets up the software accounts
conditions: One wrong answer resets the quiz back to Page 1 ('Incorrect Answer! Quiz reset to Page 1'). Answering that there is no PC/laptop and WiFi ends the application. Videos have a countdown before Next unlocks. 'Reset Quiz & Video Progress' starts it over.

what_it_is: Xfnite has used platform and processing fees since 2017. The platform fee is 4% (development and maintenance). The processing fee is 12% plus a fixed $2 (payment handling costs and risks). Xfnite only pays for correctly completed work, and the benchmark rate can start lower while the system evaluates accuracy, then improve over time.
how_to: Read the Welcome to Xfnite pop-up
Click Agree & Continue
conditions: There is no registration or activation fee. Fees are deducted from payouts.

where: Sidebar > Onboarding (Dashboard: XFNITE Onboarding - Complete Your Training)
what_it_is: The onboarding checklist on the Dashboard. It has five steps: Download Our Software, Install the Software, Basic Labeling videos, 3D & Multilayer guide, and the Answer Key. Overall Progress shows how many are done.
how_to: Open Onboarding from the sidebar
Finish the steps in order
When it says Onboarding Complete, click Continue to Account Info
conditions: Steps unlock in order. Account Info stays locked until onboarding is complete ('Complete your onboarding to unlock your Account Info'). The live-session step is temporarily stopped and is skipped automatically.

what_it_is: Downloads all the software used in the Hands-on Training: 7-zip for Windows, VC-Redists, and Ginger Software.
how_to: Download 7-zip for Windows
Download VC-Redists
Download Ginger Software
conditions: Ginger is for PC or laptop only (Windows). It does not run on a cellphone.

what_it_is: A four-item installation checklist for 7-Zip, the Visual C runtimes, and Ginger.
how_to: Install 7-Zip (7z2301-x64.exe)
Right-click Visual-C-Runtimes-All-in-One.zip > 7-Zip > Extract Here
Open the Visual-C-Runtimes-All-in-One folder and run install_all.bat, then wait for it to finish
Right-click Ginger.zip > 7-Zip > Extract Here
Tick each item, then click Mark as Done
conditions: Keep the extracted Ginger folder on Drive C to avoid errors.

where: Onboarding > Watch Training Videos: Basic Labeling Guide
what_it_is: Three videos to watch before the Hands-on Training: Part 1 Labeling Basics, Part 2 Techniques, Part 3 Switching.
how_to: Play each video
Watch until the Next button unlocks
Move to the next part
conditions: Each video must be watched almost fully and its countdown must reach zero before moving on.

where: Onboarding > Watch Training Videos: 3D & Multilayer Guide
what_it_is: Five 3D guide slides (Task Overview, Labeling the Footprint, Setting the Vector, Selecting the Label, Generating 3D Lines) plus two videos: How to Draw 3D Lines and 3D Overview.
how_to: Read each 3D guide slide
Watch Part 2: How to Draw 3D Lines
Watch Part 3: 3D Overview
conditions: Slides and videos have a countdown before Next unlocks.

topic: Video countdown and the Next button
what_it_is: The Next button shows a countdown while a video plays. It unlocks once the countdown reaches zero and the video is watched almost to the end.
how_to: Click Play Video
Let the video play (skipping ahead does not count)
Click Finish Video or Next once it unlocks
conditions: The countdown is based on the video length. Rewinding or not finishing keeps Next locked.

where: Onboarding > Answer Key (then Answer Key Library)
what_it_is: Answer key tasks that show how training tasks should be labeled, some with videos. After all are reviewed, the Answer Key Library stays available to search any task.
how_to: Open each answer key task (Visited marks it)
Watch the task videos
Use Search tasks in the Answer Key Library for reference later
conditions: The Answer Key is locked until all earlier modules are complete. All 15 answer key tasks must be opened to finish this step.

what_it_is: Shows the profile (Username, Default Role, Authority Level), Trainings Completed, Software Accounts (Ginger User ID and Password with copy buttons), and Group & Team Chat links.
how_to: Open Account Info from the sidebar
Use Copy Username / Copy Password for the Ginger login
Click Refresh Software Accounts if the accounts do not show yet
Click Show Guide for the Ginger login guide
conditions: Locked until onboarding is complete.

where: Ginger desktop software (credentials from Account Info)
what_it_is: Ginger is the desktop labeling software. Members log in with the Ginger ID and password from Account Info.
how_to: Open ginger-202*.exe from the extracted Ginger folder
Choose Agree
Enter the Ginger ID and Password from Account Info
If Ginger asks to update, let it update, then restart Ginger
conditions: Ginger credentials appear only after onboarding is complete. Copy and paste them to avoid typing mistakes or extra spaces.

what_it_is: There are two Ginger versions. 2D Ginger is for Standard Building Repair, Landcover, Transportation and Centerline tasks. 3D Ginger is for 3D Matching and 3DR roof tasks.
how_to: Click Download Software at the top of the page
Choose 2D or 3D Ginger based on the task
Extract it and move the folder to Drive C
conditions: The 3D version is a separate app with the same name in a different folder.

what_it_is: Common Ginger tools taught in the guides: Spacebar completes or connects a shape; the F tool draws right-angle lines; hovering a line and pressing 1 adds a point; hovering a point and pressing 2 deletes it; the Vector tool is key 3; X and Z are the repair tools; S, F, G and T tools can be switched while labeling.
how_to: Draw the lines of the label
Before connecting the last point, press Spacebar to complete the shape
Switch tools while labeling as needed
conditions: The Rectangle Split tool is temporarily disabled; the guides show an alternative way.

what_it_is: For 3D tasks, the label follows the building's ground footprint, not the triangular roof shape. Balconies count as part of the footprint. A building with a visible sidewall is a 3D building.
how_to: Label the footprint of the house or building
Set the vector once per task (Vector tool or key 3): click an edge or sidewall, trace the angle, click again to set the end
Select the label
Hold CTRL and drag down until the yellow dashed 3D lines appear
conditions: Only one vector is needed per task; it applies to all features in that task.

what_it_is: A task with mistakes can be returned (pushed back) by a Checker with comments. Returned tasks do not appear in Ginger automatically.
how_to: Download tasks regularly to receive returned tasks
Read the Checker comments
Fix all the errors
Resubmit the task
conditions: The training 'Congratulations' pop-up also only appears after downloading tasks again.

where: Ginger desktop software (shown in Projects > Training as Standard Building)
what_it_is: The first hands-on training, done in Ginger after onboarding. Passing it unlocks Projects, Wallet, Attendance, and the Challengers chat lounge.
how_to: Get the Ginger ID and password from Account Info
Open Ginger and download the training tasks
Label, submit, and fix any returned tasks until passed
conditions: Standard Building stays Ongoing until passed and has no Pause/Register button. Until it is passed the sidebar says 'Pass the Standard Building training in the desktop software to unlock Projects and Wallet'.

topic: Locked pages and what unlocks them
what_it_is: Pages unlock as the member progresses. Account Info unlocks after onboarding. Projects and Wallet unlock after passing Standard Building. Leaderboard unlocks after Standard Building plus Rules & Guidelines. Attendance unlocks after Standard Building.
how_to: Check the lock notice at the bottom of the sidebar
Finish the stage it mentions
conditions: Staff roles (checker, judger, recruiter, admin) are not locked.

what_it_is: The Projects hub with four tabs: Rules and Guidelines, Active Projects, Performance Query, and Overall Task Summary.
how_to: Open Projects from the sidebar
Finish Rules and Guidelines first
Then use Active Projects, Performance Query and Task Summary
conditions: Active Projects and Task Summary are locked until Rules & Guidelines are acknowledged.

what_it_is: A step-by-step lesson on the work rules: Task Area guidelines, Green Mask guidelines, the Final Work Area, The 4 Basic Techniques, guideline images to download, and a final form. Finishing it shows 'Rules acknowledged! Access unlocked.'
how_to: Go through each step and watch the videos
Click Download Required to save the guideline images
Answer the final form, typing the rules exactly as shown
Submit to unlock Active Projects and Task Summary
conditions: Typed answers must match exactly, including capitalization, punctuation and spelling. 'Reset Progress' starts over, and 'Review Rules & Guidelines' reopens it later.

topic: Work area rules (Red Grid and Green Mask)
where: Rules and Guidelines > Task Area / Green Mask / Final Work Area
what_it_is: Only label inside the big red grid (the Task Area). Don't label buildings touching the left and upper lines; do label buildings touching the right and bottom lines. Show the Green Mask and label buildings inside or touching it within the Task Area. Red Grid plus Green Mask is the final work area.
how_to: Find the red grid of the task
Turn on the Green Mask
Label only buildings that are in the red grid and inside or touching the green mask
conditions: Don't label if there is a red grid but no green mask, or a green mask outside the red grid. Houses inside a yellow outline don't need labeling.

what_it_is: The core rules members agree to: never submit or autopass unedited or unreviewed tasks; draw and cut straight lines as much as possible; the Golden Rule is to review the whole task and repair all errors, including comments, always; no low-quality tasks; not following the rules can mean zero salary.
how_to: Review the whole task from the first grid to the last
Fix every error and every checker comment before submitting
conditions: Xfnite only pays for correctly completed work.

what_it_is: Tips for landcover work: turn on the 3rd product type for road and road-connected features and keep road edits minimal; use group category and right-click to change categories quickly; learn how to close a region properly; no need to edit nature features; learn each topology error and the tool that fixes it; fix your own errors and add comments before reporting a neighbor; tree canopy connection errors are fixed in your own task, not reported.
how_to: Read Important Guidelines in Active Projects
Apply the tips while labeling
conditions: These apply to Landcover projects.

topic: After Rules and Guidelines: Hands-On Training Completed
what_it_is: A congratulations screen that confirms the member can now work on Xfnite projects. Some projects need extra specialized training first (3D Matching, Landcover, Transportation); others only need the Hands-On Training. It also lists the Three Qualities of a Challenger: Determination, Initiative, Growth.
how_to: Click Start Journey
Check which projects need specialized training
conditions: Team Managers guide members through project-specific training when needed.

what_it_is: Lists each training with Project ID, Name, Project Status (Running or Closed), Training Status, Passed Task, Total Task and actions. Training Status can be Passed, Ongoing, Unregistered, Paused or Closed.
how_to: Click Register to start a training (Reopen if it was paused)
Open Ginger and download the training tasks
Click Pause to pause it
Click Guides for the training materials
conditions: Only one training can be active at a time; other buttons are disabled with 'Another training is currently active'. Trainings marked Closed cannot be started. Standard Building has no button.

what_it_is: How to begin Landcover, Transportation or Roof training. After clicking Register, a 'Training Unlocked' message confirms the account is being registered for that training.
how_to: Click Register (or Reopen) on the training
Read the training guide that pops up
Open Ginger and download the training tasks
Complete all training tasks and submit them for review
conditions: Checkers usually review training tasks within 1 to 3 days, sometimes within a few hours. To switch trainings, pause the current one first.

what_it_is: Video-based training for landcover labeling: common tools, drawing overpasses, connecting to neighbors, fixing topology errors, tutorials for training tasks 1 to 18, driveways and parkings, and man-made stage 2.
how_to: Click Register on Landcover Training
Watch the instructional videos
Open 2D Ginger and download the Landcover training tasks
conditions: Uses the 2D Ginger software.

what_it_is: A more challenging training with a Training Guide (Google Drive) and an Answer Key to study first.
how_to: Click Register on Transportation Training
Read the Training Guide
Review the Answer Key
Click Start Training, then open 2D Ginger and download the tasks
conditions: Only 5 major-error pushbacks are allowed during this training. A pushback is when a Checker returns a task because of significant mistakes.

what_it_is: High-precision 3D roof training with a Training Guide folder, a 3D Roof Errors guide for common errors and crashes, and the Ginger software package for roof training.
how_to: Click Register on Roof Training
Open the Training Guide and the 3D Roof Errors guide
Download the roof Ginger software
Click Start Training, then download the training tasks
conditions: Uses the 3D Ginger software. Roof and 3D Match trainings may be temporarily disabled at times.

what_it_is: Opens the training library for that training: searchable videos, the Training Guide, the Answer Key, and for roof, the 3D Roof Errors guide and software.
how_to: Click Guides beside the training
Search or open the material needed
conditions: Available for Landcover, Transportation and Roof trainings.

what_it_is: After passing both Landcover Training and Transportation Training, a 'Certification Completed!' message confirms eligibility to register for live projects.
how_to: Pass Landcover Training
Pass Transportation Training
Click Start Active Projects
conditions: If the wait is long, contact the Team Manager or post in the Community Chat so the Judgers can verify the account.

what_it_is: Shown when Landcover, Transportation and Roof are passed but the account has no group or team yet. Judgers verify the account, then assign a Checker Guild.
how_to: Wait for the Judgers to verify the account
Join the assigned guild chat
Connect with the Checker Guild Leader
conditions: If it takes a while, contact the Team Manager or post in the Community Chat.

what_it_is: The list of active live projects with Project ID, Name, Status, Started Date, Task Num, Registered? and an action button.
how_to: Find the project in Active Projects
Click Register (Register Project)
Wait for the 'Registration Successful!' message
Open Ginger and start taking tasks
conditions: Some live projects require a specialized training first. The Dungeon Coordinator completes the registration.

what_it_is: Shows work speed per project: Avg Task Pace (minutes per task), Overall Avg Speed (features per hour), Work Time, Tasks and Features, with Today, Yesterday, Daily and All-Time views. Pace labels range from Slowest Pace, Lagging Behind and Below Standard to Steady Pace, Excellent Speed and Unmatched Speed.
how_to: Open Performance Query
Pick the time range
Use Show Previous Projects to see older projects
conditions: Numbers update as the system records work time; recently done tasks may take time to appear.

what_it_is: Statistics for a selected project: task completion, finished features, project metadata, and how many tasks are in each stage (Initialized, Labeler Editing, Labeler Submit, Checker Editing, Checker Submit, Checker Pushed Back, Judger Editing, Reviewer Editing, Finished).
how_to: Open Overall Task Summary
Select an annotation project
Read the Task State Distribution
conditions: Locked until Rules & Guidelines are acknowledged.

what_it_is: Pop-ups that warn when speed is below the required pace in some projects (Performance Alerts) or when last week's work hours were lower than expected (Low Work Hours Warning).
how_to: Read the warning
Tick the acknowledgment box
Log more consistent hours or improve pace while keeping quality
conditions: These are reminders, not penalties by themselves.

what_it_is: Shows the Final Payment (current estimated salary), the Withdraw button, and Payout History. Some roles can click the Final Payment card to see the computation details.
how_to: Open Wallet from the sidebar
Check Final Payment and Payout History on the Overview tab
conditions: The Wallet is locked until Standard Building is passed.

what_it_is: Withdrawals send the balance to the saved payment method. A 6-digit OTP sent by email confirms each withdrawal.
how_to: Set up a payment method first
Click Withdraw
Review the Withdraw Funds details
Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to the email
Confirm; the request is received and processed
Track it in Payout History
conditions: An OTP can't be requested again until the resend timer ends. Check the spam or promotions folder if the OTP doesn't arrive.

what_it_is: The Withdraw button is disabled when no payment method is set ('Please set a payment method first'), when the balance hasn't reached the minimum withdrawal amount, or when the salary is still Processing.
how_to: Make sure a payment method is saved
Keep working until the balance reaches the minimum
Wait for the next cut-off if the salary shows Processing
conditions: Other messages: 'Withdrawals are temporarily disabled' (system-wide pause), 'Admin temporarily disabled withdrawal for your role' (role pause), 'Status does not allow withdrawal' (payout status not claimable yet).

what_it_is: The salary shows 'Processing... Please wait for next cut-off' when the wallet balance hasn't reached the minimum needed to display it, or when admins have salaries on hold for a role. Earnings are not lost; they carry over.
how_to: Keep doing live tasks to grow the balance
Wait for the next cut-off
conditions: When on hold by role, a queue shows how many people are ahead and an estimated wait. Very new accounts may also see their salary hidden at first.

what_it_is: Lists past payouts with date, Total Payout and Status. 'Sent' means it was sent to the payment method. A queue position means it is still being processed. 'Stopped, Please fix issue first.' means there is a payout problem.
how_to: Scroll to Payout History
Check each payout's status
conditions: Problem statuses include: Invalid/Blurred QR, Update MOP, Change MOP, payment name doesn't match the account holder or immediate family, GCash Error, No MOP. All of them are fixed by updating the payment method.

what_it_is: Where the payout account is saved. Providers: GCash, Maya, Binance, PayPal, BPI, BDO, Security Bank, GoTyme, Landbank, Metrobank, or Other Bank.
how_to: Open Wallet > Payment Method and click Add (or Change) Payment Method
Select the payment provider
Enter First Name, Last Name and the account number twice
Upload a clear payment QR code (required)
Enter the 6-digit OTP sent to the email
Confirm the details and save
conditions: The name on the payment method must match the account holder or an immediate family member. The QR code is required. Check spam or promotions if the OTP is missing; expired OTPs need a new request.

what_it_is: Shown when the payment method's last name doesn't match the account's last name. Until it's fixed, only User Settings and the Wallet can be opened.
how_to: Click Update Wallet Payment and correct the payment details
Or click Update Account Settings if the account name is wrong
Save so both last names match
conditions: A similar walkthrough appears when the QR image or payment method is missing.

what_it_is: LXP is a loyalty balance earned from quests. The page shows Available Loyalty Balance, Rank Status, Next Rank, Total Accumulated and Daily Quests Completed. LXP unlocks custom features and rewards.
how_to: Complete daily quests to earn LXP
Check progress on the Loyalty Points page
conditions: LXP is separate from salary.

what_it_is: Members can refer friends with their referral link and earn 10% of each referral's payout, capped at PHP 1,000 per referral.
how_to: Open Refer & Earn in the sidebar
Click Copy Referral Link
Share it with friends who want to join
conditions: Friends Recruited shows how many joined through the link.

what_it_is: For team leaders: estimated salaries and payout history of team members, with hours, benchmark, raw amount, referral fee, platform fee, processing fee, unclaimed amount and final payment.
how_to: Open Wallet > Team Payout
Filter or search team members
conditions: Only visible to roles that lead a team.

where: Sidebar (Onboarding steps 1 and 2) and Account Info
what_it_is: Members are asked to join the Facebook Messenger Community Chat for real-time project updates and answer keys, and the official Facebook Group. The Group Code must not be shared with others.
how_to: Click Join Community Chat in the sidebar
Click Join Facebook Group and confirm membership
Proceed to Projects
conditions: Team chat links (Checker and Judger group chats) appear in Account Info once assigned.

what_it_is: Built-in chat with lounges by role: an applicants lounge, the Challengers lounge for passers, the OGXF lounge for veterans, and staff group chats. Messages support replies, editing, unsending and image attachments up to 10MB.
how_to: Open the chat widget
Pick a lounge tab
Type a message or attach an image
conditions: The Challengers lounge unlocks after passing Standard Building. OGXF is only for OGXF members.

what_it_is: Main Quests follow the journey chapters (complete onboarding, finish Rules and Guidelines, take a live project, get assigned a guild, submit a first live task). Daily quests include Daily Check-In (log in daily), The Daily Bounty (submit 10 live tasks in Ginger), The Bards Ballad (add a song to the DJ Booth) and The 60-Minute Harmony (listen to the DJ Booth for 60 minutes). Side quests include referring a friend.
how_to: Open the Quest Log
Do the listed actions
Earn LXP for completed quests
conditions: Some quest steps may show as temporarily disabled (e.g. 3D Match or Roof training).

what_it_is: A shared music player. Members can paste a YouTube link to add a song to the queue and listen together.
how_to: Open the DJ Booth
Paste a YouTube link
Add it to the queue
conditions: Adding songs and listening time count toward daily quests.

what_it_is: Rankings with two categories: Top Challengers and Top Checkers. The member's own rank is highlighted.
how_to: Open Leaderboard
Choose Top Challengers or Top Checkers
conditions: Unlocks after passing Standard Building and finishing Rules & Guidelines.

what_it_is: The Attendance Log for training meetings and project updates. Each session shows Date & Time, Meeting Title and Attended / Not Attended.
how_to: Open Attendance
Click Check In on the meeting (or open the shared check-in link)
Enter the meeting passcode
Click Check In
conditions: Unlocks after passing Standard Building. Admins and judgers schedule the meetings.

what_it_is: Profile and security settings: First and Last Name, Facebook link, Phone Number, password change, Ginger Credentials (verified with the Ginger server when saved), and a Danger Zone to delete the account.
how_to: Open Settings
Edit the fields
Confirm Profile Changes
conditions: A name change and a Facebook link change can each be requested only once and go to admin review. Payouts are not processed to fake, alias or placeholder names. Deleting the account is permanent and needs typing 'delete'.

what_it_is: The header has Announcements (payout updates and notices; a red dot means new), Theme (light or dark), Settings, Help & Support, and Download Software. Profile change requests show their admin review result here.
how_to: Click the bell to read announcements
Use the menu for Theme, Settings or Help & Support
conditions: Offline members see new announcements on their next login.

what_it_is: Roles have game-style titles: Novice (applicant), Challenger (labeler), Veteran (old labeler), Mentor (recruiter), Overseer (checker), Arbiter (judger), Grandmaster (admin).
how_to: Check the badge beside a name in chat or rankings
conditions: The Dungeon Coordinator handles registrations for trainings and projects.
